title: Sr. HR Executive
description:
Position - HR Executive

Location- **Ghiloth, Rajasthan**

Experience- 5+ yrs

Required Skills-

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for plant personnel, including permanent operators, supervisors, staff, and contractual labor.
* Coordinate walk-in drives, local sourcing, interviews, background checks, and formal joining/induction formalities.
* Maintain statutory registers, display mandatory factory notices, and coordinate with labor, safety, and government audit inspections.
* Strong working knowledge of local labor laws.
* Proficiency in HRIS and MS Excel

Interested one can share resume at **hr.ex@zantex.in**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
